levels.name: The Moon Realm
levels.objective: Restore the moon's voice, then return through the portal.

landing.name: Moonlit landing
landing.description: A silver desert stretches east. The western portal returns to the oasis.

temple.name: Temple of the Moon
temple.description: A silver bell hangs in silence. Its inscription asks you to RING BELL.

features.bell: No tool is needed. The bell waits for a human hand.

puzzles.response: Silver notes cross the desert. The moon remembers its voice.

portals.description: A star-filled portal is set into the eastern arch.
The western portal shows the familiar oasis.
